topic: The Magic of Light: Principles of Holography and Diffraction

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Wave Nature of Light
lecture_lines: Light waves undergo superposition and interference.
Diffraction is light bending around obstacles.
This is the foundation for holography.
animations: Show wave crests moving across screen in white color (#FFFFFF).
Display two beams (reference and object) interfering at a plane.
Color the interference pattern bright blue (#0000FF).

sections.title: The Mechanism of Holography: Recording Phase
animations: Show laser beam splitting into two paths using a mirror.
Display object scattering light onto a photographic plate.
Show the reference beam hitting the plate simultaneously.

sections.title: The Reconstruction: Diffraction in Action
lecture_lines: The hologram acts as a diffraction grating.
Shining the reference beam reconstructs wavefronts.
animations: Show the hologram plate illuminated by reference light.
Display light diffracting through the plate to form image.
Highlight the reconstructed wave front in green (#00FF00).

sections.title: Mathematical Integration: The Fresnel-Kirchhoff Formula
lecture_lines: We model light via an integral.
Intensity patterns map to the film.

Animate integral terms appearing around the hologram plane.
